description: Confirm the initial task membership and source/destination/work-area bindings against the original instruction and the observed permanent instances. Initial Responses inventory is a proposal. For processing tasks, select current input objects; future products need not exist yet. An operator-configured region is an external setting, not a visible marker. Confirm the requested region binding, not its imaginary painted boundary. For all/count tasks, independently check visible source completeness; do not infer hidden contents from a candidate count. Return confirmed bindings and ledger evidence, or unknown with the specific unmet question. No motion or capture is inserted. Source means the original support/container/region of selected inputs, not the input material itself. An object cannot be its own source; source origin, target membership and final destination are distinct judgments.
